subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should maintainers port the WebChat user-turn durability work from #80670 through the current shared recorder path, or require a fresh current-main browser/context repro before more code changes?
rationale: The issue is a real user-facing bug class, but current main has partial mitigations and the open candidate fix is conflicting and was previously blocked on owner-boundary concerns.

options.title: Port #80670 Through Shared Recorder
options.body: Adopt the useful durability goal from #80670, rework it onto current main's shared recorder/session boundary, and prove busy same-session, rollover, media, hooks, UI history, and context assembly.

options.title: Require Fresh Current-Main Proof
options.body: Pause code work until a maintainer or reporter captures a current-main WebChat reproduction with UI, chat.history, transcript, and assembled context evidence.

options.title: Close Only With End-To-End Proof
options.body: Close this issue only if current main is proven to preserve user-before-assistant order and avoid duplicate inbound context without needing #80670.

recommendation.title: Port #80670 Through Shared Recorder
recommendation.body: Adopt the useful durability goal from #80670, rework it onto current main's shared recorder/session boundary, and prove busy same-session, rollover, media, hooks, UI history, and context assembly.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining fix decision centers on the shared user-turn recorder boundary that current main uses for Gateway/runtime/fallback transcript persistence.
